outcomeNote: Two juxtaposed aggadic characterizations of the same failing; the sugya does not set them against each other or decide between them.

segments.he: אָמַר עוּלָּא: כָּל הַקּוֹרֵא קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע בְּלֹא תְּפִילִּין, כְּאִילּוּ מֵעִיד עֵדוּת שֶׁקֶר בְּעַצְמוֹ. אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: כְּאִילּוּ הִקְרִיב עוֹלָה בְּלֹא מִנְחָה, וְזֶבַח בְּלֹא נְסָכִים.
segments.en: With regard to the recitation of Shema without phylacteries, «Ulla said: Anyone who recites Shema without phylacteries, it is as if he has borne false testimony against himself,» as in Shema, he mentions his obligation to don phylacteries and in this case fails to don them himself (Talmidei Rabbeinu Yona). «Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan said:» One who recites Shema without phylacteries, «it is as if he has offered a burnt-offering without a meal-offering or a peace-offering without libations.» Despite the fact that he fulfilled his obligation, his offering is incomplete.

moves.summary: reciting Shema without phylacteries is like bearing false witness against oneself
moves.about: R' Yoḥanan's comparison of one who recites Shema without phylacteries to one who brings an incomplete offering

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי חייא בר אבא אמר רבי יוחנן
moves.summary: a second characterization in R' Yoḥanan's name — it is like an offering brought without its accompaniments
